author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal + grad-clip=0.50 — tri-seed (seed=7)
abstract: Tri-seed replication for HDP‑RegCal with global-norm gradient clipping=0.50. Baseline seed=42 showed avg 0.6901 with CRI-Off 0.0909. Tests stability.
